decisions.reason: This bracket is close to the core infrastructure offering, uses existing fabrication know-how and customer relationships, and is therefore a low-cost option worth keeping open.
The pipe support bracket directly extends the established range for existing customers, so management would likely retain it because uncertainty is limited and the cost of continuing is low.

Although the public waste bin is more distant from the core business, it still exploits the firm's metalworking and coating capabilities and can be kept as a relatively inexpensive diversification option while demand remains uncertain.

The waste-bin-with-ashtray line is outside the main pipeline business but fits municipal customers and existing production skills well enough that its option value still justifies keeping it on the market.

Outdoor public ashtrays are a more peripheral niche, but because they share fabrication and coating resources with the rest of the range, management would likely keep them unless clearer evidence of weak demand emerges.
